meta.title: Lesson 2 settings: which real days and weeks to show, and the sourced anchors
meta.note: All curves are processed 2025 hourly profiles of the Southwest Power Pool (town_days.json, town_year.json; EIA-930: implausible demand hours rebuilt from the day-ahead forecast, frozen solar telemetry filled from nearby days, solar zeroed after dark; the named days contain no rebuilt or filled hours), scaled so that Prairie Town's highest hour of 2025 is town_peak_mw, the same scale as lesson 0 (town.json, scenario lesson0, demandPeakMW). The solar slider adds a hypothetical solar farm that follows SPP's solar shape of the chosen day; its MW is the farm's output in SPP's top solar hour of 2025 (an illustrative maximum, not a nameplate rating).

summer.label: 29 July 2025
summer.note: SPP's highest hour of 2025 fell on this day

winter.label: 21 January 2025
winter.note: a cold winter day with a morning and an evening hump; picked by the data builder among days with no repaired hours

duck.label: 30 May 2025
duck.note: the April-May day with the most solar relative to demand

heat.quote: Hot weather, which increases electricity demand for cooling, combined with an underlying trend of demand increases
heat.what: EIA on the July 2025 records; the article also names data centers and manufacturing in forecast demand growth
heat.source: EIA, Today in Energy: U.S. electricity peak demand set new records twice in July

us_peak.what: Record coincident peak demand of the Lower 48 states, 29 July 2025 (the same day as SPP's 2025 peak)
us_peak.as_of: article of 5 August 2025, from preliminary hourly data

us_year.what: Total U.S. electricity consumption in 2025, the highest on record
us_year.source: EIA, Electricity explained: Use of electricity

net_load.quote: the demand remaining after subtracting variable renewable generation
net_load.what: EIA's definition of net load, in its article on California's deepening duck curve
net_load.source: EIA, Today in Energy: As solar capacity grows, duck curves are getting deeper in California

spp.what: SPP's 2025 totals and shares (annual demand, peak hour, solar share of net generation) as computed from the EIA-930 files listed in town_days.json meta, in its `stats` block
spp.source: EIA, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (Form EIA-930), six-month BALANCE files 2025 (on the Grid Monitor's dashboard: Download Data → Six-Month Files), balancing authority SWPP
